title: Self-evolving network verifiers
abstract: arXiv:2608.11340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symbolic network verifiers can reason about correctness across vast spaces of routing inputs and failures, but only for the protocols and features an expert has encoded by hand. Creating and maintaining a faithful model of the control plane is both difficult and never-ending, since no written source specifies perfectly what a network does: vendor implementations deviate from the RFCs, and behaviour shifts with releases. The burden of constant upkeep ultimately keeps verification out of many networks that need it.   We argue that the model should instead evolve automatically to faithfully capture the actual network behaviour. To achieve that, we leverage the only source that specifies it unambiguously: the router software itself. In a counterexample-guided loop, a coding agent proposes extensions to the verifier's symbolic encoding, while a trusted oracle (e.g., emulated routers) supplies the ground-truth routing state. translated_title: 自我演进的网络验证器
translated_abstract: 符号网络验证器能够在庞大的路由输入和故障空间上推理正确性，但仅限于专家手动编码的协议和功能。创建和维护控制平面的忠实模型既困难又永无止境，因为没有书面来源能完美规定网络的实际行为：供应商实现偏离RFC，行为随版本变化而改变。持续维护的负担最终使得验证在许多需要它的网络中无法实施。我们认为，模型应该自动演进以忠实捕获实际网络行为。为实现这一目标，我们利用唯一能明确指定网络行为的来源：路由器软件本身。在反例引导的循环中，编码代理提议扩展验证器的符号编码，而可信赖的预言机（例如，模拟路由器）提供真实路由状态。代理迭代地...
tldr: 本文提出了一种自我演进的网络验证器方法，通过利用路由器软件作为唯一真实来源，在反例引导下自动扩展符号编码，以解决手工建模维护困难且不准确的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-evolving network verifier approach that leverages router software as the sole ground-truth source to automatically extend symbolic encoding in a counterexample-guided loop, addressing the challenges of manual model maintenance and inaccuracy.
